description.en: Short links, clean URLs, and a little less friction when sharing things.
description.zh: 把长网址变成简洁的短链接，让分享少一点麻烦。

source.description: TypeScript URL shortener with clean links and analytics-ready storage

subject.en: Original golden faceted bee with multicolored wings
subject.zh: 保留原图的金色碎片化蜜蜂与多彩翅膀

description.en: The bee, antenna curls, wing spread, and original off-center balance remain unchanged. The native 2048 px canvas already gives the complete mark ample rounded-corner clearance.
description.zh: 蜜蜂、卷曲触角、展开的翅膀和原来的偏心平衡全部保留。2048 像素原图已经为完整主体留出了充分的圆角安全空间。

description.en: Broad honey and amber facets lead the body; the existing cyan-and-rose wing group supplies the colorful interest point. All source pixels and the transparent silhouette remain untouched.
description.zh: 蜂蜜金与琥珀色面构成主体，现有青粉色翅膀形成集中多彩的兴趣点。源图像素和透明轮廓均未修改。

description.en: Sparse oversized honeycomb cells sit around a warm beeswax field. Their uneven rhythm, light edges, fine grain, and shallow contact shadow support the bee without turning the logo into a scene.
description.zh: 稀疏的大蜂巢格分布在暖蜂蜡底色周围，不均匀的节奏、细亮边、颗粒和浅接触阴影衬托蜜蜂，保持标识的简洁。

sizeNote.en: The golden body and cyan-pink wing group remain distinct at 32 px. At 16 px the antenna curls and smaller facets simplify into the overall silhouette; sidebar and browser marks use the transparent foreground.
sizeNote.zh: 32 像素时金色身体和青粉翅膀仍能区分；16 像素时触角卷曲与小碎片会融入整体轮廓。侧栏和浏览器标记继续使用透明前景。

goal.en: Keep personal links, Markdown ideas, and nested todos together, with short-link sharing and unified search.
goal.zh: 集中整理个人链接、Markdown 想法和层级待办，通过短链接分享并统一搜索内容。

role.zh: 短链接跳转与 D1 代理

description.en: Large, irregular honeycomb cells sit apart, tracing the quiet structure of beeswax.
description.zh: 疏落的大型不规则蜂房描出蜂蜡结构，与蜜蜂的轻盈姿态相互呼应。

caption.zh: 把分享的路径缩短一点。

description.en: Golden faceted bee with multicolored wings.
description.zh: 金色碎片化蜜蜂与多彩翅膀。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥47px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 47px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
